headline: What to Prepare Before You Start Bathroom Plumbing Work
articleBody:
Thinking about upgrading your bathroom plumbing? Getting a few things squared away beforehand can really smooth out the whole process. It's not just about picking out shiny new fixtures; it's about understanding what's going on behind your walls and floors. Being prepared helps us give you the best advice and ensures your project moves along efficiently, staying local to the East Bay area as we typically do.

Here’s what you should consider getting ready:

- [ ]  **Verify pipe and drain locations** — why it matters: Before any demolition, knowing the exact layout of your existing pipes and drains is crucial. This prevents costly surprises and helps confirm if your desired new fixture placement is feasible without extensive pipe relocation.
- [ ]  **Check for concealed leaks or water damage** — why it matters: Water damage can hide behind walls or under flooring. Identifying it early means we can address it properly during the remodel, preventing bigger issues down the line and ensuring a solid foundation for your new plumbing.
- [ ]  **Understand local permit requirements** — why it matters: Permit rules vary. Some jobs, like relocating fixtures or replacing a tub/shower enclosure, often need permits, while a like-for-like sink swap might not. Knowing this upfront avoids delays and ensures compliance.
- [ ]  **Gather details on your desired fixtures** — why it matters: Have information on the compatibility of new fixtures with existing supply and waste connections, their dimensions, and serviceability. This helps us ensure everything will fit and function perfectly.
- [ ]  **Discuss wall and floor opening restoration** — why it matters: Plumbing work often requires opening up walls or floors for access. Having a clear plan for how these finishes will be restored is important for the overall project timeline and budget, ensuring a seamless look when we're done.

How to use this checklist: Go through these items and gather as much information as you can. It helps us understand your situation better from the get-go. This preparation allows us to focus on doing the work with quality, as we are very involved on a daily basis with every project.

Have questions or ready to talk through your checklist? Contact Frasheski Construction for expert guidance on your bathroom plumbing upgrade.
